purpose: Machine-readable guide for tuning the video frame pages, referred to by the user as PPT pages.

concept.ppt_meaning_in_this_project: The PPT is not a .pptx file. It is a set of static 1080x1920 PNG scene cards rendered by Python/Pillow, then held on screen for each scene duration.
concept.video_assembly: build/frames.txt lists each static PNG and its duration. ffmpeg concat turns these static pages into video frames.

render_scene.responsibility: Render one 1080x1920 PNG for each Scene.

make_background.responsibility: Create the dark editorial gradient background and accent glow.

draw_header.responsibility: Draw scene label, title, and bottom progress bar.

draw_scene_visual.responsibility: Dispatch to one of the visual renderer functions based on scene.visual.

draw_three_nodes_visual.best_for: three reasons, three risks, three conclusions

draw_five_tasks_visual.best_for: action list, next steps, priority list

fields.video.footer: Small bottom-left footer text on every page.
fields.scene.title: Small colored title near the top.
fields.scene.headline: Main large page title. Use \n for deliberate line breaks.
fields.scene.accent: RGB color controlling page highlight color.
fields.scene.visual_texts: Overrides labels inside the selected graphic.

safe_microtuning_examples.edit: Modify scenes[i].headline in the input JSON.

safe_microtuning_examples.goal: Make page duration shorter or longer
safe_microtuning_examples.edit: Modify scenes[i].narration, because page duration follows the total TTS audio duration for that scene.

code_level_tuning.use_when: Only edit Python when JSON fields are not enough.

common_targets.how_to_tune: Change y/top/start_y constants inside the matching visual function.
Increase value to move subtitle upward; decrease to move it downward.
Decrease for more line breaks; increase for fewer line breaks.

preview_workflow.multi_frame_strip: Extract several PNGs, then hstack them with ffmpeg for visual comparison.

important_constraints: Do not remove fps=30 before subtitles in render_video.
Do not use Edge WordBoundary timestamps as the final subtitle timing source.
Do not let large subtitles exceed the horizontal safe area; use ASS \N display wrapping.
For vcut TTS, keep each subtitle audio chunk under the provider limit. Current split_subtitles max is 16 chars before display wrapping.
When only subtitle style changes, reuse build/narration.wav and re-run render_video; do not call TTS again.
